q: I have worked at my company for 3 years. How much annual leave do I get?
why: Employment Act s.60E(1)(b) - 12 days for 2 to under 5 years.

q: What notice must my employer give before terminating my contract?
why: Employment Act s.12(2) - 4/6/8 weeks by length of service. Accept digits or words.

q: How much maternity leave am I entitled to?
why: Employment Act s.37 - 98 consecutive days.

q: How many days of paid sick leave can I take in a year?
why: Employment Act s.60F - graduated by length of service.

q: At what age can my employer force me to retire?
why: Minimum Retirement Age Act 2012 s.4 - 60 years.

q: How does a trade union get recognised by an employer?
why: Industrial Relations Act 1967, recognition provisions.

q: Does someone need a licence to lend money as a business?
why: Moneylenders Act 1951.

q: Can a company process my personal data without asking me first?
why: Personal Data Protection Act 2010.

q: What duties does a company director owe to the company?
why: Companies Act 2016.

q: If the government takes my land, how is compensation decided?
why: Land Acquisition Act 1960.

q: What did the Federal Court decide about constructive dismissal in 2019?
why: Case law is not in the corpus at all.

q: What is the current minimum wage in Malaysia?
why: Set by a Minimum Wages Order (subsidiary legislation), not a principal Act.

q: What must my employer contribute to my EPF each month?
why: EPF Act 1991 IS indexed at full corpus size, so answering is correct. Was a refuse case when only 2 Acts existed.

q: Am I covered by SOCSO if I am injured travelling to work?
why: Employees' Social Security Act 1969 IS indexed. Refusing here is a false refusal.

q: What are the grounds for divorce under Selangor Syariah law?
why: State enactments are outside a federal-Acts corpus.

q: Under the Contracts Act 1950, what makes an agreement void?
why: Contracts Act 1950 is only published as a scan; not in the corpus.

q: Which documents are chargeable with stamp duty?
why: Stamp Act 1949 IS indexed. The rates live in subsidiary legislation, but the charging provisions do not.

q: Under Singapore's Employment Act, how much notice must an employer give?
why: Foreign law. Definitively absent, and semantically adjacent enough that retrieval will offer Malaysian employment provisions as neighbours.

q: What changes did the 2027 amendment to the Employment Act make?
why: Does not exist. Tests whether it invents an amendment rather than declining.

q: My employer gave me two weeks notice. Is that enough?
why: Cross-act trap: 'notice' appears across many Acts; must land on employment.

q: Can I be dismissed without a reason being given?
why: Cross-act trap: should reach Industrial Relations, not company law.

q: How do I register a trade union?
why: Cross-act trap: 'registration' appears in hundreds of Acts.
